firstPlayerRule: Whoever woke earliest today starts. For consecutive games, one of the previous game's losers starts the next game.
houseFallback: If the starting criterion is tied or unclear, agree to choose randomly among the eligible players. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise, with an action phase followed by cleanup.
The consecutive-game instruction does not specify how to choose between multiple losing players.
This answer covers the original game's regular rules. Tournament rules and the later anniversary edition are separate.
